notes: One-node circular list: the handle at 0x8c200e00 holds the sentinel 0x8c200f00, whose next word points at node 0x8c201000; the node's next word points back at the sentinel. The loop therefore runs one iteration, frees the node through the 0x8c01032c thunk, and exits with sentinel->next = sentinel->prev = sentinel. free(0x8c201000) takes the shortcut described in 0x8c159fc0.json: size 0x40 negated at 0x8c200ffc, top chunk shrunk, free-list insert at 0x8c200fd0, coalescing skipped because mem[0x8c220004] = 0x80000000 reads negative, bin walk at 0x8c210004 stops immediately. T ends 1 from the exit cmp/eq.
